_comment: Ordning: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ironman_guide (ändrad 26 okt 2026, hämtad 2026-11-24). Guiden delar bara in i faser (Early-game, Mid-game, Approaching late-game) och anger ingen ordning inom en fas, så ordningen inom paketet är ett eget förslag utifrån krav och nytta.
Guiden nämner under Mid-game: Elite void, Dragon warhammer och Bow of Faerdhinen; crystal armour från Corrupted Gauntlet
under Approaching late-game. Lunar spellbook, Ancient Magicks, Ash sanctifier och Prifddinas nämns inte.
Avvikelser: guiden lägger Fire cape och Slayer helmet under Early-game och Zenyte under late-game; de är med här enligt uppdraget.
Paketet innehåller bara referenser till andra templates och anteckningar, ingen egen kravdata; delarna verifieras i

Version 2 (milstolpe 15): Barrows set, Toxic blowpipe + Serpentine helm, Trident of the swamp, Moons of Peril och Dragonfire shield, godkänt av användaren 2026-11-24. Ordningen är ett eget förslag; guiden har inte kontrollerats för dem.
name: Mid ironman
description: Mid ironman unlocks and gear in a suggested order, from the Lunar spellbook to the Bow of Faerdhinen

children.note: Lunar Diplomacy opens NPC Contact, Vengeance and many utility spells for the rest of the game.
Desert Treasure I gives ice spells for multi-combat slayer and bossing.
A full Barrows set is strong early-mid gear. Ahrim's is the default; insert the Barrows set template on its own for another brother.
The best melee cape until the Infernal cape. The guide counts it as an early milestone.
Makes every slayer task faster; the guide counts it as an early milestone.
Zulrah gives the blowpipe for fast ranged damage and the serpentine helm against venom.
A powered staff for magic slayer and bossing, upgraded at Zulrah.
Three armour sets and weapons that cover all styles.
A key gear upgrade in the guide for higher-level bossing and raids.
Turns demonic ashes into Prayer XP while slaying, after the hard Kourend & Kebos Diary.
Dragonfire protection with good defensive stats.
Strong amulets and rings from demonic gorillas. The guide lists zenyte among late-game highlights.
Song of the Elves opens the elf city, needed for the Gauntlet below.
A key upgrade in the guide: its special attack lowers bosses' Defence.
A key upgrade in the guide from the Corrupted Gauntlet, the end-game ranged setup for many irons.
